definitions.gloss: years; months and years; time; passage of time
definitions.explanation: A period of time, typically a long one spanning years. Often used to emphasize the duration or passage of time.

examples.japanese: {年月|ねんげつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}つ→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧。
{年月|ねんげつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}つ→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦もの→もの：02259_mono⟧⟦だ→だ：noentry⟧。
examples.notes: 年月が経つ is a common expression for the passage of time

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{年月|ねんげつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}させた→完成：01550_kansei⟧。
examples.english: It was completed over many years.

examples.japanese: ⟦あれ→あれ：00916_are⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{随分|ずいぶん}→随分：01256_zuibun⟧{年月|ねんげつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れた→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
examples.english: A lot of time has passed since then.
examples.notes: 年月が流れる also means 'time passes'

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{年月|ねんげつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{傷|いた}んで→傷む：noentry⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: This building has gradually deteriorated over many years.

notes:
READING: Also read as としつき, which is a native Japanese reading with the same meaning. ねんげつ is the more common reading in formal contexts.

PATTERNS:
・{年月|ねんげつ}をかける (to spend years on)
・{年月|ねんげつ}が{経|た}つ/{過|す}ぎる (time passes)
・{年月|ねんげつ}が{流|なが}れる (time flows/passes)
・{長|なが}い{年月|ねんげつ} (many years)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{歳月|さいげつ} (years, time - more literary)
・{時間|じかん} (time - general)
・{月日|つきひ} (days and months, time)
